description: Cloud-Native Application Protection Platform based on Prowler OSS

features.name: Local full-stack environment
features.description: UI + API + Worker + PostgreSQL + Valkey + Neo4j running locally
features.definition_of_done: docker compose up starts all services, UI accessible at localhost

features.name: CI/CD pipeline for fork
features.description: GitHub Actions for lint, test, build
features.definition_of_done: Push to branch triggers lint+test, PR gates pass

features.name: AWS scan end-to-end
features.description: Scan AWS account, view results in UI and Neo4j graph
features.definition_of_done: Scan completes, findings visible in UI, attack paths in Neo4j

features.name: Multi-cloud graph ingestion (Azure)
features.description: Extend Cartography ingestion for Azure resources
features.definition_of_done: Azure resources appear as nodes in Neo4j graph after scan

features.name: Multi-cloud graph ingestion (GCP)
features.description: Extend Cartography ingestion for GCP resources
features.definition_of_done: GCP resources appear as nodes in Neo4j graph after scan

features.name: Toxic combination detection
features.description: Attack path patterns: public+vulnerable+high-priv, lateral movement, data exfil
features.definition_of_done: Cypher queries detect top-10 attack patterns, scored by risk

features.name: Graph visualization UI
features.description: Interactive graph explorer with attack path step-by-step
features.definition_of_done: React Flow/Cytoscape renders graph, click-through attack paths

features.name: Agentless VM scanning (AWS)
features.description: EBS snapshot → mount → scan filesystem for vulns, secrets, malware
features.definition_of_done: EC2 instances scanned without agent, CVEs reported in findings

features.name: Agentless VM scanning (Azure/GCP)
features.description: Disk snapshot scan for Azure VMs and GCE instances
features.definition_of_done: Azure/GCP VMs scanned, findings in graph

features.name: Container image scanning
features.description: Scan ECR/ACR/GCR images + running containers in EKS/AKS/GKE
features.definition_of_done: SBOM generated, vulnerabilities mapped to graph nodes

features.name: Incremental & parallel scanning
features.description: Only scan changes, parallel Celery workers, scheduling
features.definition_of_done: Re-scan takes <30% time of full scan, configurable schedule

features.name: Effective permission analysis
features.description: Parse IAM/RBAC policies across AWS/Azure/GCP, compute effective perms
features.definition_of_done: API returns effective permissions per identity with policy chain

features.name: Over-privileged identity detection
features.description: Compare granted vs used permissions via CloudTrail/activity logs
features.definition_of_done: Dashboard shows over-privileged identities with recommendations

features.name: Privilege escalation paths
features.description: Graph-based detection of priv-esc chains
features.definition_of_done: Cypher queries find escalation paths, visualized in graph UI

features.name: Data discovery & classification
features.description: Scan S3/Blob/GCS for PII/PHI/PCI via sampling
features.definition_of_done: Data stores classified with sensitivity labels in inventory

features.name: Data risk analysis
features.description: Public stores with sensitive data, unencrypted, over-permissioned access
features.definition_of_done: Alerts fire for exposed sensitive data, paths in graph

features.name: Cloud event ingestion
features.description: Real-time CloudTrail/Activity Log/Audit Log via EventBridge/SQS/PubSub
features.definition_of_done: Events ingested within 5min of occurrence, stored for query

features.name: Detection rules engine
features.description: SIGMA-like rules for credential compromise, priv-esc, exfil, cryptomining
features.definition_of_done: Built-in rules trigger alerts, custom rules via UI

features.name: Alert routing & response
features.description: Slack/PagerDuty/webhook alerts, correlation, automated playbooks
features.definition_of_done: Alerts delivered to configured channels within 1min of detection

features.name: Multi-tenancy hardening
features.description: RLS isolation, per-tenant Neo4j, quotas, rate limiting
features.definition_of_done: Tenant A cannot access Tenant B data under any API call

features.name: Enterprise auth (SSO/SAML/OIDC)
features.description: SSO login, RBAC roles, audit logging, API keys
features.definition_of_done: SAML IdP login works, roles enforced, audit trail complete

features.name: Production Kubernetes deployment
features.description: Helm chart, auto-scaling workers, monitoring, DR
features.definition_of_done: Helm install deploys full stack, scales under load
